question: What is the average lifespan of a pure human in the world of Re:Zero?
answer:
Well... I think it would be shorter than in modern times, so perhaps around 60 years.

That would make Wilhelm a little worrying, wouldn't it? (laughs)

But Wilhelm is healthy, so I don't think that's really an issue for him.

It may vary somewhat depending on one's standard of living.

Since Wilhelm serves a ducal house, he should receive a proper salary and probably has savings. As a member of the Sword Saint lineage, he should also receive rewards from the country.

Considering all that, Wilhelm wouldn't be representative of the average.

For ordinary people living in a normal town, I think an average lifespan of around 60 years would be about right.
